mechanism: Phenobarbital is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases clotrimazole metabolism, reducing its antifungal plasma concentrations and efficacy.
action: Consider alternative antifungal agents not significantly metabolized by CYP3A4 (such as terbinafine or fluconazole at higher doses) or monitor clotrimazole therapeutic response closely and adjust dosing if needed.
